-- report
SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS total FROM users
WHERE age > 18 AND city = 'Rome' /* adults */
GROUP BY name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
insert into t values (1, 2.5, null);
select 'unterminated

«k|WHERE» age > «n|18» «k|AND» city = «s|'Rome'» «c|/* adults */»
